root_cause.text: The vulnerability exists because the `ltk_is_valid` function in the Bluetooth MGMT subsystem omitted a bounds check on the user-provided `enc_size` against the `key->val` buffer size, permitting out-of-bounds writes during stack-based reply operations.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the addition of `if (key->enc_size > sizeof(key->val)) return false;` inside `ltk_is_valid` in `net/bluetooth/mgmt.c`, and the CVE description confirms that an `enc_size` larger than the 16-byte key buffer causes a reply stack buffer overflow.
